note: Goals are LOCAL to the repository crsi runs in. This file declares the catalog-maintainer CRSI campaign for the Local Mind catalogue in ~/yijunyu.github.io. `owned` is exclusive to this loop; nothing here owns a path in any ds4-rs repository.

loops.landing: direct-to-main, committed locally; push only when the user authorises publishing in that session
loops.policy_source: the catalog-maintainer subagent session that declared this campaign, 2026-11-22, launched from -Users-yijun-ds4-rs-metal; model id claude-opus-5-5. Round 0 only; later rounds record their own policy.
loops.benchmark: candidates-2026-11-22 (frozen, 50 upstream LLMs: 25 latest + 25 popular; rules and sources inside the file)
loops.kpi: C = covered / candidates over the newest frozen candidates file; covered = a measured row of the same upstream model on a box it fits, or an explicit does-not-fit row. Secondary: share of picks on the Pareto front (decode, memory, context, coding capability), GB of benchmark weights on the internal disk
harness: ~/.claude/agents/catalog-maintainer.md (role: measurement method, retirement and Pareto rules)

device.purpose: one measurement at a time on the Studio, never beside a ds4-server or bench/v41_* job; mini and the M2 Max laptop are preferred where the model fits

loops.standing: C baseline 13/50 = 0.26 from rows existing at 9286bf4; 14/50 = 0.28 after round 0 (Inkling-2-Mini base measured)
